title: Too big to brake: why Bangladesh and Pakistan escaped the visa brake, and what comes next
summary_en: A High Court judgment shows that several key sending countries had a near miss in being included in the UK Home Office's study visa breaks. With fresh compliance requirements looming, universities have been left to manage the largest markets themselves – but could fresh changes be on the horizon? Spencer Withrington investigates.
author: Spencer Withrington
title_cn: Too big to brake: why Bangladesh and Pakistan escaped the visa brake, and what comes next
